location.zh: 大嶼山梅窩銀礦灣海濱
location.en: Silver Mine Bay, Mui Wo, Lantau

desc.zh: 年度最盛大嘅端午競渡，設公開組、女子組、混合組及親子體驗組。賽後設龍舟飯及頒獎典禮，歡迎全港市民到場打氣。
desc.en: The biggest race of the year, with open, women's, mixed and family-fun categories. Dragon boat feast and awards ceremony after the race. All welcome.

title.en: Dragon Boat Taster Day (Free for Beginners)

desc.zh: 從未扒過龍舟都得！由教練教授基本槳法，再落水實戰一圈。費用全免，名額 40 人，額滿即止。
desc.en: Never paddled before? No problem. Coaches teach the basics, then you hit the water. Free of charge, 40 spots only.

location.en: Dragon Boat Club Pier, Mui Wo

desc.zh: 為端午正賽而設嘅 4 週集訓，由鼓手、槳法到起航配合逐一打磨。參加者需自備運動裝備，本會提供槳具。
desc.en: A 4-week camp ahead of the main race, polishing drumming, stroke and start coordination. Bring sports gear; paddles provided.

location.en: Tin Hau Temple Plaza, Mui Wo

desc.zh: 競渡前一日的傳統祭龍儀式，由長者為龍頭點睛開光，祈求風調雨順、出入平安。歡迎街坊一同參與。
desc.en: Traditional pre-race ritual: elders dot the eyes of the dragon head to bless the boat. Neighbours welcome to join.

title.en: Dragon Boat Culture Charity Night Run

desc.zh: 結合龍舟文化展覽嘅夜間慈善跑，報名費全數撥捐青年龍舟培訓計劃。設 3km 及 8km 兩個組別。
desc.en: A night charity run paired with a dragon boat culture exhibition. All entry fees go to the youth dragon boat training programme. 3km & 8km categories.

desc.zh: 休賽季期間嘅體能及技術維持課程，包括划槳機、核心訓練及戰術分析，為下屆賽季儲備實力。
desc.en: Off-season fitness and technique maintenance: ergo, core training and race tactics — building up for the next season.
